notes.title: Work-in-Progress: Graphics Update & Optimization
notes.notes:
Hey Stalkers! We’ve been hard at work polishing the graphics and making the game run smoother — here’s a sneak peek at what’s coming.  
Visual upgrades: 
Added dynamic shadows for a more immersive atmosphere.,

Introduced HDR, bringing richer colors, deeper contrasts, and a more natural, eye-friendly look.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35864315/b24cfecf3bfe5240bc3805baf17e1cee766eaac3.png"]
  Performance optimization: 
Right now, even objects you can’t see (hidden behind walls or obstacles) are still rendered in the background — adding unnecessary load to the system. We’re implementing an optimized rendering system that cuts off everything outside your field of view, making the game run faster and smoother.  Screenshots: 
[olist]
First-person view,

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35864315/e59c5edc2e3b0c561d7d09b4cf95e92f3733bca3.png"]

Side view – current rendering,

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35864315/8a24cf738b53135e1de3601015d7cce6079a39a5.png"]

Side view – optimized rendering,

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35864315/eaae5c01c9c8adc7bf19454a064e25c3ebe1134a.png"]
[/olist]
 Stay tuned — this is just one step in making the Zone both more beautiful and more stable.

notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35864315/4f4aa08acddff71167bec25ef97e040f53b04f8c.jpg

Tomorrow a patch will be installed to all servers.

* Arena victories are now rewarded with Arena Champion Coupons (limit — 50 per day). These can be exchanged with the Bookmaker for weapons and useful buffs (see below).

Buffs similar to clan base buffs have been added. Their effects are approximately 70% of the base buffs and do not stack with them.
  Buffs can be exchanged with the Bookmaker NPC for Arena Champion Coupons:

  * "Chunky" Cocktail: +40 bullet resistance — 35 Coupons
  * "Master" Cocktail: +150 explosion resistance, +40 health — 40 Coupons
  * Morphine Shot: +6 HP/sec, removes intoxication — 40 Coupons
  * "Sprinter" Cocktail: +14 stamina regeneration — 30 Coupons
    Available at the Workbench:
  * "Jaeger" Cocktail: +60 melee damage resistance
  * Herbal Brew: +40 melee damage resistance
  * "Hercules": +40 kg carry weight
  * "Tonic": +20 kg carry weight
    All of the above items are *non-personal* — they can be traded or sold to other players for silver.

The following weapons and attachments are also available from the Bookmaker for Arena Champion Coupons:

  * FN F2000 Assault Rifle — 3000 Coupons
  * Taurus Hunter 460 Revolver — 2000 Coupons
  * M110 Sniper Rifle — 2000 Coupons
  * FN F2000 Underbarrel Grenade Launcher — 500 Coupons
  * Taurus Hunter Optical Sight — 800 Coupons
  All of the above weapons can be restored.

A Premium Subscription has been added (available for 30, 90, 180, or 360 days):

  * x2 silver from quests and x2 experience from killing mutants and completing quests
  * 40% discount on repairs from NPCs
  * 50% discount on guide/fast-travel services
  * +20% silver when selling artifacts and mutant parts to the trader
  * Buying a 180-day subscription gives 1 Premium Coupon; a 360-day subscription gives 2. These can be exchanged with the Bookmaker for attachments or paint kits
  * XP Pills, Journals, and Spark no longer give bonus experience. As compensation, all players will automatically receive 10 days of Premium upon first login after the update
  * All Premium Subscriptions are tradable items — they can be given or sold to other players for silver.
ATTENTION! After purchasing the Premium Subscription item, be it from the store or from other players, you must ACTIVATE it by right-clicking on it. The Premium will not work unless activated.

* Reward suits available from the Bookmaker for Premium Fighter Coupons have been revised. Their stats match the KB-M2 suit (30-day version):

  * "Kid" Suit
  * "Horse" Suit
  * "Ghillie" Suit
  * "Predator" Suit

* Free fast-travel has been removed from the "Chem Burial Site" base. Instead, 100 units of gasoline are now provided daily

* The weight buff at "The Mine" Settlement base has been reduced from 100 kg to 60 kg

* Health and stamina indicators have been fixed and expanded; a premium icon has been added

* New quests for premium bolts are available from the NPC "Trader"

* Fixed several issues linked to client crashes

* Character menu redesigned

notes.title: Anomaly Zone welcomes a major update!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35864315/4bc151d92a219cba6bfae7bb74e4f0216b139bfe.jpg
Stalkers, it's time for new challenges and thrilling battles. Prove your faction's dominance and unlock unique rewards and powerful new weapons!

🏅 New Event — "Clan Rating"

Every three months clans compete for leadership. At the end of each season, members of the top three clans will receive special coupons, exchangeable for cases with valuable and unique rewards.

🔸 Clan rating points are awarded for:
Capturing and defending bases
Capturing and defending fortified points
Killing enemy clan members
Picking up Artifacts A, B, Y (only the first pick-up after spawn counts)
Picking up Samuel's Heart (only the first pick-up after spawn counts)
Picking up the "Zap A" artifact (only the first pick-up after spawn counts)

📍 Clan rating boards locations:
Lubech — Railway station building
Market — Next to the Bookmaker
Vesuvius — Radio tower
Lubech Area — Gourmet Village
Tunguska — Radius settlement

⚔️ New Weapons and Exchanges

Machine gun PKP "Pecheneg" added as a reward for clan activities. (Transferable weapon, no clan binding)
Clan rating coupons can be exchanged for prizes with the new NPC Vitalya Ricochet ("Organizer").

📘 New Season Pass — "Echo of the Legend: The Swamp Doctor"

🔹 Added a new Season Pass featuring:
Swamp Doctor Suit
OTS-14 "Thunder" Rifle with an integrated grenade launcher

The Season Pass XP system has been updated and streamlined:
XP now automatically awarded for killing mutants
Additional XP earned for arena victories and completing Gourmet and Crocodile quest lines
Increased number of Season Pass tasks across all difficulty levels

🛡 Game Security

Easy Anti-Cheat has been implemented. Continued improvements to game security will follow.

🔧 Additional Improvements

Added CZ-75 Pistol
Added Elephant Gun M2 Magazine (5 rounds)

🔹 Items now available for restoration:
Black Stalker Suit
Swamp Doctor Suit
FLASH Rocket Launcher
"Raven" Set
"Cerberus" Set
CZ-75 Pistol
OTS-14 "Thunder" Rifle
PKP "Pecheneg" Machine Gun

🔹 Updated exchange with Major Kuznetsov for "Tokens For Military Merit"
🔹 Updated clan registration interface with the Recruiter (availability check for clan names added)
🔹 Rebalanced APS M2 and Elephant Gun M2 pistol magazines
🔹 Improved damage registration mechanics
🔹 Fixed bugs in multiple quests
🔹 Numerous minor bugs fixed and game stability enhanced

🚀 Good luck and exciting adventures in the updated Zone!

notes.title: Update 1.5.4
Story update and the new outfit!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35864315/f53ff4ce4ba37c6d5e0333be5c6c8518e67f8b1f.jpg

The new set "Wanderer" finally on PvP and PvE servers!

This set, consisting of Armor, Jacket, Pants, Mask and Bandana, will go to those who, more or less, have completed all significant quests in the game. You may say, without much exaggeration, that by having received the "Wanderer" set as quest reward, you have closed the existing storyline of Anomaly Zone by 100%.


The Medical Mask also was added!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35864315/7727cd8248580ab1333370744d42936b35a627bc.jpg

Now you can get the Medical Mask on the PvP and PvE servers!
 
To do this, complete the Recruiters quest, which can be taken from the bulletin board in the Gourmet Village.


Added Patterns with Art for the Wanderer Mask!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35864315/15e23e8005df6e4767f3b8e90d04e58370ca9256.jpg

Now you can apply one of twelve patterns to the Wanderer Mask. To do this, you need to go through the Recruiters quest, after receiving the Mask and talking with Cutter.
 
Patterns with pictures are distributed by different NPCs of the Zone, at the end of the Recruiters' quest. Find them all!

Have a nice game!

notes.title: Story Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35864315/6a797ffa7a6e66936daef9bad7dd7b1e87fa4e32.jpg

A new quest storyline was added, with new NPCs. This quests are the part of the main storyline. To start go to the Borzhch bar, find Andrew and get the quest "A Dangerous Artifact". Uncover the secrets of the mysterious Brethren of the Zone!

Good luck!

notes.title: Patch 1.4.5
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35864315/ed7cb8c4dbaba1f7bf4559fba1bd0726ced10223.jpg

1. Changed and rebalanced medical items and other consumables with beneficial effects, such as tinctures, first-aid kits and injectors.

2. Christmas suits were added, including Snow Maiden looks for the female character model. You can get Christmas costume through barter with Santa in the alternative version of Lubetch.

3. New Christmas backpacks.

4. From now on the Holiday Firework is used as a grenade, and not as a mine. The timer from this item was removed.

5. Holiday quests and a festive version of Lubetch are activated.

6. A new mutant and the related quests for the hunt were added as a continuation of the Reverend story.

7. A new NPC Practician with his own quests. You can find him in the camp at the Radio Tower in the Vesuvius region.

8. Fixed bugs and glitches of game maps and gameplay.

Coming soon:

New quest line to access the battle with an unique boss.
Separate arena for the battle with the boss!

Follow the news. Await the update soon!

Thank you for your patience and support!
